Porte-Saint-Martin (10e arr.) — Paris, France

Average day Average night

In detail

The same December 2024 prefectural closure order (see Porte-Saint-Denis) extends into this quartier, covering boulevard Saint-Denis, rue du Faubourg-Saint-Martin and rue de la Fidélité — the latter also has a longstanding, separately documented history as a street-prostitution area near Gare de l'Est. Together this points to genuine, officially-acknowledged nighttime disorder along these boulevards rather than a daytime problem; by day the area is a busy, ordinary commercial strip. Sources checked: Mairie du 10e, 'Arrêté préfectoral: les commerces fermés dès 20h à Château d'Eau', Dec 2024.
